wikipedia.title: Cold-shock_domain
wikipedia.extract: In molecular biology, the cold-shock domain (CSD) is a protein domain of about 70 amino acids which has been found in prokaryotic and eukaryotic DNA-binding proteins. Part of this domain is highly similar to the RNP-1 RNA-binding motif.

representative_structure.name: Crystal structure of the Thermotoga maritima cold shock protein mutant Est#13 in complex with AacEst
